tests.name: Twenty-one self-contained examples preserve original IDs and advertise replacement and declared-history scope
Each example has two valid physical forty-card decks with five-card openings and remaining order
get and list return fresh copies, without changing the active baraja
Unknown or prototype-like example identifiers are rejected
Spark example executes one protection and two real attacks, preserving both damage payments and fresh replay
Spirit example keeps the Ashuna cost banished while denying its summon, without assuming prior Synchro history
Invoked example reaches the advertised physical field and recovery through registered manual actions
Swordsoul guide performs its seven physical steps and draws before the search shuffles
Branded guide uses Deck materials and a separate physical discard in two steps
Tenyi guide spends the Ashuna banish and Shaman discard while reviving its actually Link Summoned Monk
Salamangreat guide distinguishes declining Roar Set from recovering Roar with reincarnated Wolf
Roar guide resolves the physical Counter Trap chain before using Fusion materials
Declining the own Roar counter leaves Fusion materials in hand and prevents Mechaba
Roar example does not invent a counter from a Trap set this turn or without the own Link
Crow guide keeps both hand costs in GY and preserves Aleister for a second physical Mechaba
Crow guide without Mechaba pays the same discard and removes the material needed by Invocation
Droll guide opens only after the physical search and preserves both costs when Mechaba negates it
Droll guide without response applies the symmetric lock and closes the old search window
Field Spell guide replaces the prior field before the counter chain and reaches reincarnated Wolf with recovered Roar
Field Spell guide without its Roar counter never restores the prior field after Mechaba negates Sanctuary
Field Spell guide does not invent the own Roar counter from a card Set this turn
load waits for both workbenches and initializes the chosen example without executing actions
Every added example loads its declared initial state without autoplay or external fixture files
Busy search or comparison is rejected before any deck change
Failed readiness and missing APIs cannot partially import the baraja
A custom banlist context is rejected before replacing the deck
Skills or malformed Skills are rejected before replacing the deck
Concurrent load calls are rejected while the first waits for readiness
A rejected import releases the loading guard and never starts the laboratory
